{{CharInfobox |color={{gold color}} |corecolor={{gold color light}} |bordercolor={{gold color dark}} |name=Jimmy |jname=ケンタ |tmname=Kenta |slogan=no |image=Jimmy artwork.png |size=120px |caption=Art from ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Purple |hair=Dark Blue |hometown=[[New Bark Town]] |region=[[Johto]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=counterpart |counterpart={{ga|Ethan}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=The Legend of Thunder! |epname=The Legend of Thunder! |enva=[[Sean Schemmel]] |java=[[Kenji Nojima]] |manga=no }} '''Jimmy''' (Japanese: '''ケンタ''' ''Kenta'') is one of the main protagonists of ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', along with {{jo|Marina}} and [[Vincent]]. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[New Bark Town]]. ==History== ===Pre-series=== [[File:LoT first partners.png|thumb|250px|left|Jimmy and his friends]] Jimmy's [[first partner Pokémon]] was {{p|Cyndaquil}}, which he received from [[Professor Elm]] of [[New Bark Town]] at the same time as [[Vincent]] and {{jo|Marina}}. Despite being close friends, the trio did not travel together and went their separate ways. However, they crossed paths occasionally in their {{pkmn|journey}}s. In one of his meetings with Marina, he {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{p|Weedle}}, which eventually [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Beedrill}}. He was also able to capture and train at least four other Pokémon. [[File:Jimmy and Cyndaquil.png|thumb|220px|Jimmy and his first Pokémon]] In the midst of his journey, Jimmy and Cyndaquil were defeated by a [[Silver (game)#Counterparts|mysterious young man]] and his {{p|Nidoking}}, who became one of his most powerful rivals. Jimmy then left on a mission to become increasingly strong. During his journey, he had many one on one battles with other Trainers, only winning half of them. He eventually got his Cyndaquil to evolve into a {{p|Quilava}} and then a {{p|Typhlosion}}, thus allowing him to fight on equal terms with his rival and win. After some time, he earned at least eight [[Badge]]s and was able to participate in the [[Silver Conference]] with Marina a full year before [[Vincent]] did. ===''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''=== In ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', Jimmy accepted {{OBP|Shinji|The Legend of Thunder!}}'s one-on-one battle challenge and defeated his {{p|Hitmonlee}}. Jimmy later located the nearest [[Pokémon Center]] and had his Pokémon healed. He overheard a familiar voice, which belonged to Marina, who was busy talking to Vincent on the Center's videophone. They had a battle where, although Marina showed the results of their training, Jimmy still took the lead, defeating {{jo|Marina}}'s {{DL|Marina (Johto)|Pink|Jigglypuff}} and almost defeating [[Wani-Wani]]. The battle was interrupted however by the actions of a group of [[Team Rocket]] who were working nearby. In his attempt to save the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{OBP|Raikou|The Legend of Thunder!}}, Jimmy's Typhlosion was defeated by [[Attila]] and [[Hun]], though [[Little Miss]] was able to defeat the duo's Pokémon with {{m|Perish Song}}. He also took the wounded Raikou to the nearby [[Pokémon Center]]. During the treatment of Raikou, Jimmy met the mysterious Legendary Pokémon expert called [[Eusine|Eugene]], he claimed that Raikou attacked by retaliation, but Jimmy denied it. Raikou awoke the following morning, stunned. Jimmy tried to talk to it, but it attacked and escaped into the surrounding forest. Jimmy, Marina, and the others tried to follow it and confronted Attila and Hun again. They battled the duo, and they were saved by Vincent, who suddenly arrived. Eventually, the Trainers were able to free Raikou from the Miracle Crystal System and defeat Team Rocket. Jimmy's efforts finally earned the trust of Raikou, and Jimmy said goodbye to it as it returned to the wilderness. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN116|Pride of a Champion!]]'', Jimmy appeared watching the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match between {{an|Lance}} and [[Diantha]] on TV alongside Marina and Vincent. ==Character== [[File:The Legend of Thunder Part 1.png|left|thumb|220px|Jimmy and Marina in ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'']] [[File:Jimmy Marina Vincent JN.png|thumb|220px|Jimmy and his friends in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] Jimmy has an energetic personality. He has a habit of saying "You rock and you rule!" ("OK! Perfect!" in the original Japanese version) to his Pokémon and giving them a thumbs-up after winning a battle. He can be quick to jump to conclusions but also knows when to be serious and get the job done. Jimmy cares for his Pokémon very much, and he was determined to protect {{OBP|Raikou|The Legend of Thunder!}} from [[Hun]] and [[Attila]]'s scheme. Jimmy doesn't mind losing a round, as he is driven to learn as much as he can. He has a battle style that focuses on offense. As such, his Pokémon are trained to take attacks and still keep fighting. His main goal was to become a strong [[Pokémon Trainer]] so that he could protect the kids in [[New Bark Town]], his [[hometown]]. He also has a crush on {{jo|Marina}}, which appears to be mutual. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Jimmy's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Jimmy |pkmn=Typhlosion |stage1=Cyndaquil |stage2=Quilava |type1=Fire |img=Jimmy Typhlosion.png |epnum=The Legend of Thunder! |epname=The Legend of Thunder! |vajp=Susumu Chiba |vaen=Susumu Chiba |desc={{p|Typhlosion}} was Jimmy's [[first partner Pokémon]], given to him as a {{p|Cyndaquil}} by [[Professor Elm]]. He obtained it on the same day that [[Vincent]] got his {{TP|Vincent|Chikorita}} and {{jo|Marina}} received her [[Wani-Wani|Totodile]]. Jimmy and Typhlosion are very close to each other.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jimmy |pkmn=Beedrill |stage1=Weedle |stage2=Kakuna |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Jimmy Beedrill.png |epnum=The Legend of Thunder! |epname=The Legend of Thunder! |desc=Jimmy caught {{p|Beedrill}} as a {{p|Weedle}} during his Pokémon journey. It had already [[Evolution|evolved]] twice before ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''. He used it in a {{pkmn|battle}} against {{jo|Marina}}'s {{p|Jigglypuff}}, Pink, which Beedrill won. Jimmy relies on Beedrill's speed during battles and flight situations where it proves itself very useful. Beedrill's known moves are {{m|Agility}}, {{m|Twineedle}}, and {{m|Pin Missile}}.}} Jimmy also has at least four other Pokémon, as he was seen with six Poké Balls during ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', two of which contained Typhlosion and Beedrill. ===Temporary=== {{TrainerPoké |main=Raikou (The Legend of Thunder!) |trainer=Jimmy |pkmn=Raikou |type1=Electric |img=Raikou LoT.png |epnum=The Legend of Thunder! |epname=The Legend of Thunder! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc=Jimmy met {{p|Raikou}} while it was being targeted by [[Team Rocket]]'s Miracle Crystal. In an attempt to prevent it from being caught by the villainous duo, Jimmy battled them with his Typhlosion and Marina's help. The duo were able to escape and Jimmy took it to a [[Pokémon Center]]. When Raikou became severely injured later on by the crystal's force field, his Typhlosion volunteered to drain the energy from it, thus freeing Raikou and giving him a chance to destroy it once and for all.}} ==Achievements== ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Jimmy has obtained in the [[Johto]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (one year before ''[[EP268|Tie One On!]]) ===Pokémon League=== Jimmy has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Silver Conference]] - (one year before ''[[EP268|Tie One On!]]) ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{gold color}}|bordercolor={{gold color light}} |ja=野島健児 ''[[Kenji Nojima]]'' |en=[[Sean Schemmel]] |it=Paolo de Santis |fr_eu=Gaëtan Wenders |pt_br=Rodrigo Andreatto |es_la=Alan Prieto |es_eu=David Robles}} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{gold color dark}}; background: #{{gold color}};" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{gold color dark}}; background: #{{gold color light}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:Sugimori Jimmy anime.png|300px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{gold color dark}}; background: #{{gold color light}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:Jimmy_Promotional_Artwork.png|250px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{gold color dark}}; background: #{{gold color light}}; width:140px; height:140px"| [[File:TLOT eyecatch 01.png|300px]] |- style="font-size: 80%;" | {{color2|000|Ken Sugimori}}'s design of Jimmy for the animated series. | Promotional artwork from ''{{color2|000|The Legend of Thunder!}}'' |Jimmy's Eyecatch |} ==Trivia== [[File:Ethan Donphan.png|thumb|250px|Ethan in ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'']] * Much like {{Ash}} is based on {{ga|Red}}, Jimmy is based on {{ga|Ethan}}. However, a separate character made a cameo in the beginning of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'', battling against Ash with a {{p|Donphan}}. Unlike Jimmy, that character wears Ethan's updated clothes from {{2v2|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}, and is indeed referred to as "Hibiki" (Ethan's Japanese name) in the art gallery feature of the Japanese DVD. ** Jimmy's cameo appearance in ''[[JN116|Pride of a Champion!]]'' has him still wearing Ethan's {{2v2|Gold|Silver}} clothes instead of his HeartGold and SoulSilver ones. * When Vincent appeared in the [[Silver Conference]], Marina and Jimmy were referred to as "Dani" and "Yoshi", respectively, leading many to believe that "Yoshi" was the official English name for Jimmy, and "Dani" was the official English name for Marina. Whether this was the original intention remains unknown. * Jimmy's English name may come directly from {{2v2|Gold|Silver}}. There is a minor Trainer named "Kenta" in the Japanese version whose name was localized as "Jimmy" in the English translation - a {{tc|Youngster}} on {{rt|3|Kanto}} with a {{p|Raticate}} and {{p|Arbok}}. The dubbers may have mistaken this character as an unrelated animated series character. The same thing happened to Vincent. * Jimmy is the only animated series character based on a player character who has met his opposite-gender counterpart, as he is good friends with Marina, who is based on {{ga|Kris}}. ==Names== {| style="float:left; background: #{{gold color light}}; {{roundy|10px}}; border: 3px solid #{{gold color}}" |- style="text-align:center;" !
